ATC TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Eligibility Criteria: Bidding may be submitted only by the Original Equipment Manuf acturer (OEM) or their formally Authorized Dealers/Resellers. 2. Rejection of Bid: Non-compliance with the tender terms, non-submission of required documents, lack of clarity in technical specifications, or contradictions between the bid der's specifications and supporting documents/brochures may lead to the outright rejec tion of the bid. 3. Mandatory Technical Compliance: 1. Bidders must strictly comply with all technical specifications, including additional parameters. Submission of the Technical Specification Compliance sheets is man datory. 2. Failure to submit this documentation will result in the rejection of the bid during the technical evaluation phase, and no subsequent representations will be entert ained. The university reserves all rights in this regard. 3. Bidders must strictly comply with all technical specifications stipulated in the Bu yer-Added Technical Specifications. 4. Submission of the itemized Technical Specification Compliance Sheet (Annexure –X) with explicit page/URL references to the official OEM datasheet is mandatory.

4. Additional Specification Parameters: Any additional specification parameters stip ulated in the GeM Bid Document must be fully complied with by the bidder/seller. The fi nal supply must align perfectly with these parameters; otherwise, the materials are liabl e for rejection. 5. Authorized Signatures: All documents submitted/uploaded along with the bid for ev aluation must be duly signed and stamped by the authorized representative of the firm/ company. 6. Make and Model Declaration: 1. Bidders must explicitly specify the exact make and model of the offered items. Mere reproduction or copying of the university's asked specifications without an official, printed product brochure from the OEM may lead to the rejection of the b id. 2. Both the proposed workstation and the monitor must be publicly verifiable on th e official global or national website of the OEM. The direct active web link must b e furnished in the technical bid. 7. Relocation to Permanent Campus: The successful bidder shall be fully responsible for the uninstallation, safe transfer, and re-installation of the equipment to the new per manent campus location, as and when informed by the NFSU Dharwad Campus authorit y. This service must be provided completely free of cost, including any necessary reloc ation spares or mounting adjustments, within three (3) years from the date of the initial installation. 8. Prevalence of Buyer Added ATC: These Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms and Condi tions apply directly to this bid. They modify, substitute, or supplement the clauses ment ioned in the general bid document. Whenever there is a conflict between the provisions of the standard bid document and these specific ATC clauses, the provisions contained herein shall prevail. 9. EMD Exemption: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) exemption will be provided to eligibl e categories (such as MSEs and Startups) strictly as per the Government of India norms , GFR guidelines, and GeM policies. 10. Right to Cancel/Modify: NFSU Dharwad Campus reserves the right to cancel or modi fy the bidding process, fully or partially, at any stage without incurring any financial or l egal liabilities to the participating bidders. 11. Technical Clarifications: The Campus Director, NFSU Dharwad Campus, reserves th e right to seek technical clarifications, explanations, or supporting documentary eviden ce from the tenderers at any stage of the evaluation. 12. Certifications and Benchmarks: The goods supplied must be fully certified based o n applicable national/international benchmarks (ISO, ISI, QCI, BIS, etc.). Authentic copie s of these certificates must be attached alongside the bidding documents. 13. Payment Terms: Payment shall be processed only upon the successful delivery, stan dard installation, testing, and completion of the mandatory training session. 14. After-Sales Support: The supplier must demonstrate a proven, appropriate structura l setup and operational capability to provide efficient and effective after-sales service a nd maintenance support at the Dharwad campus. 15. Inspection after Installation & Commissioning of the equipment at consignee ’s/User site: a. The goods will be inspected by Buyer / Consignee or their Authorized Representativ e or by Nominated External Inspection Agency (independently or jointly with Buyer or Consignee as decided by the Buyer) at consignee’s premises for their complianc e to the contract specifications. b. The Campus Director, NFSU Dharwad Campus shall be the final authority to reject f ull or any part of the supply which is not conforming to the specification and other t erms and conditions.

16. Defective Equipment: a. If any of the equipment supplied by the Tenderer is found to be Substandard, refur bished, un-merchantable or not in accordance with the Description/specification or otherwise faulty, the purchaser/consignee will have the right to Reject the equipme nt or its part. The prices of such equipment shall be refunded by the Tenderer with 18% interest if such payments for such equipment have already been made. All da maged or unapproved goods shall be returned at supplier's cost and risk. Defective part in Equipment, if found before installation and/or during warranty period, shall be replaced Within 30 days on receipt of the intimation from this office at the cost a nd risk of supplier Including all other charges. In the event of non-removal within the stipulated period, the said items shall be dis posed of or utilized at the sole risk and responsibility of the suppliers, without any f urther notice, and no subsequent claim or payment shall be entertained. 17. Resolution of Disputes: a) The dispute resolution mechanism to be applied pursuant shall be as follows: In cas e of Dispute or difference arising between the Purchaser and a domestic supplier Re lating to any matter arising out of or connected with this agreement, such disputes or Difference shall be settled in accordance with the Indian Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996, The rules there under and any statutory modifications or re-enactments t hereof shall apply to the arbitration proceedings. b) Arbitration shall be referred to an independent arbitrator mutually appointed by bot h parties or as per the standard dispute resolution mechanism of the GeM GTC. 19. Point of Contact: For any queries regarding the terms and conditions of this tender, please write to purchase_dharwad@nfsu.ac.in or contact the administration at +91 9481515684. SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1) Scope of Supply, Hardware & Turnkey Execution a) Comprehensive Turnkey Supply: The seller must supply, deliver, install, t est, and commission the complete high-performance Workstation unit(s) alon g with matching monitor, keyboard, mouse, power cords, and all necessary in terface cables at the designated laboratory premises. b) Single OEM Brand Alignment: To ensure seamless system integration, har dware synchronization, and centralized driver support, the Workstation CPU, Motherboard/Chassis, Monitor, Keyboard, and Mouse must be from the same Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). c) Completeness of System: The vendor must certify that the supplied workst ation package is complete in all respects, fully assembled, and tested prior to dispatch; all required internal power connectors, PCIe auxiliary power lines, a nd drive brackets must be pre-installed.

d) Pre-Installation Guidance: The vendor must officially share technical docu mentation detailing electrical load calculations, heat dissipation (BTU/hr), pow er phase requirements, and ambient laboratory prerequisites immediately up on placement of the Purchase Order. e) Pre-Dispatch Inspection & Transit Insurance: The seller shall bear all ex penses related to freight, packing, forwarding, door delivery, and comprehens ive transit insurance. Any component, chassis, or monitor panel damaged duri ng transit must be replaced immediately with brand-new OEM units at no add itional cost to the buyer. f) Spare Parts & Upgradability Guarantee: The OEM/bidder must provide a written undertaking guaranteeing the availability of genuine spare parts, repl acement power supplies, motherboard modules, and technical support for a minimum period of 4 to 6 years from the date of installation. 2) Operating System, BIOS Security & Out-of-Band Management a) Factory Preloaded Operating System: The workstation must be delivere d with factory-preloaded Windows 11 Professional (64-bit) with all OEM-certifi ed drivers, with the legal digital license key embedded directly into the syste m BIOS. The system hardware must also be fully certified and validated for e nterprise Linux distributions (Red Hat Enterprise Linux Desktop 8.3+ and Ubu ntu Desktop 22.04+). b) Proprietary Secure BIOS: The system must feature a secure, OEM-develo ped BIOS (third-party/generic BIOS is strictly prohibited) equipped with integr ated self-healing, intrusion detection, runtime firmware protection, and monit oring capabilities. c) Electronic Serial Number Verification: The unique serial number of the w orkstation must be electronically retrievable directly via native command pro mpt commands (wmic bios get serialnumber or equivalent OS queries) witho ut requiring external utilities, and must match the physical serial number lab el printed on the chassis. d) Remote Management & Virtualization: The system must possess dedica ted hardware for remote Out-of-Band (OOB) management and provide native architectural support for virtualization platforms including Docker, Singularity , and VMware ESXi (or equivalent). e) Malicious Code Certificate: The bidder/OEM must submit a formal certifica te confirming that the hardware unit, embedded operating system, and comp anion management utilities are completely free from embedded backdoors, u nauthorized telemetry, spyware, logic bombs, or unapproved remote-control channels. 3) Delivery Timelines, Handover & Documentation a) Delivery Schedule: Delivery, complete physical setup, driver validation, and functional commi ssioning must be accomplished within 30 days from the date of issuance of the GeM Contract/P urchase Order. b) Handover & Acceptance: Handover shall include physical delivery, on-site inventory verificati on, execution of diagnostic hardware burn-in tests, issuance of the official Delivery Challan, and signing of a formal Acceptance Certificate by the designated institutional authority. 4) Mandatory Technical Evaluation & Live Physical Demonstration / PoC

a) Demonstration Compliance: Bidders must strictly comply with the require ment to perform a live, physical demonstration of the quoted workstation mo del before the Technical Evaluation Committee at NFSU Dharwad Campus (or as designated by the buyer) during technical scrutiny prior to financial bid op ening, if requested. b) Validation Benchmarks: The demonstration shall verify GPU compute reco gnition, system bus bandwidth, cooling acoustic levels under stress, out-of-ba nd management functionality, and BIOS self-healing integrity. c) Rejection on Demonstration Failure: Inability to demonstrate the equipm ent or non-compliance with quoted parameters during physical evaluation sh all result in technical disqualification. 5) Installation, Commissioning & User Training a) SITC Scope: The seller shall be solely responsible for the complete unboxing , positioning, hardware setup, network configuration (dual Ethernet 1 Gbps & 10 Gbps ports), peripheral connectivity, and diagnostic testing at the designa ted laboratory premises. b) On-Site Operational Handover & Training: The seller/OEM certified techn ical specialist must provide hands-on system administration and routine main tenance guidance to faculty members and technical staff immediately followi ng commissioning at no extra charge. 6) OEM Authorization & Reseller Eligibility a) Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF): The bidder, if not the OEM, must upload a valid, tender -specific OEM Authorization Certificate directly authorizing them to bid, supply, and service the quote d workstation model, with the OEM assuming joint and several responsibilities for warranty fulfilment and technical support. b) Authorized Service Support: The bidder/OEM must maintain an established, authorized technical service center in India staffed with qualified systems engineers to ensure rapid on-site troubleshooti ng and component dispatch. 7) Warranty, Service SLA, and AMC/CMC Provisions a) Comprehensive 3-Year On-Site Warranty: The complete workstation system—including the chas sis, 24-core processor, motherboard, 64 GB DDR5 RAM, 2 TB NVMe SSD, 24 GB GDDR6 GPU, 1200W power supply, cooling units, 23.8-inch (or higher) FHD IPS monitor, keyboard, and mouse—must carr y a 03 (Three) Years Comprehensive Free On-Site OEM Warranty starting from the date of co mmissioning and CRAC issuance. b) Technical Support Response SLA: The vendor/OEM must ensure that the maximum response tim e for any critical hardware failure, component replacement, or motherboard defect shall not exceed 3 to 5 days from formal notification by the university. c) Post-Warranty Maintenance (AMC/CMC) Commitment. In compliance with standard public procurement norms, bidders must submit a formal declaration un dertaking to provide post-warranty AMC/CMC for an additional 05 (Five) Years (Years 4 to 8) as per Annexure–VII.
